subject: TOURNAMENT QA-01 (HIGH): pre-TOURN-03 tournaments are PERMANENTLY on the legacy-public joinCode path - there is no admin action that writes private/config for an existing tournament, so the code's own remediation instruction refers to a feature that does not exist
description:
Found 2026-09-17 during the A-to-Z tournament QA, read-only, no writes.

CHAIN, every link measured:
1. firestore.rules:1291 'allow read: if true' on tournaments/{id} (correct - podium/lobby need pre-auth). Both PRODUCTION tournaments still carry a joinCode field with a live value, pulled from the Firestore REST endpoint with NO credentials: 'Special Event' (status ACTIVE) and 'Cyber Tech' (ended). Shape AAA9999, 7 chars. Value deliberately not recorded here.
2. functions/index.js:7860 - with no private/config doc, codeSource='legacy-public' and the gate verifies the supplied code against that PUBLISHED field.
3. functions/index.js:7824 - joins are admitted for status 'lobby' OR 'active', and request.auth is satisfied by anonymous sign-in. So the active tournament is joinable by anyone who reads the public doc.
4. THE REAL DEFECT: console.html:11157 is the ONLY write to private/config, in the creation flow. The manage panel only READS it (:11722) and displays it (:11717). There is NO admin action to set or re-save a join code for an existing tournament. So functions/index.js:7863's instruction 'Re-save it in the admin console to close this' names an action the console does not offer, and the fallback is permanent for every pre-fix tournament.
5. Nothing clears the stale public field either: deleteField is used for unfreeze (frozenStandings/frozenAt, console.html:12082-12083) and never for joinCode. A future re-save would leave the old code published.

NOT A CODE BUG. ctf-joincode-gate.test.js:105 tests the legacy path ON PURPOSE - it exists so a live event does not break mid-flight, which was right in August. The defect is that a deliberately TEMPORARY fallback became permanent because the migration step it assumed was never built.

FIX: an admin action in the manage panel that writes tournaments/{id}/private/config AND clears the public joinCode field in the same operation, so the two live tournaments become fixable. Then re-verify with an unauthenticated REST read that the field is gone.

NOT REPRODUCED BY EXECUTION: the join itself was not performed - that is a production write into a real tournament. Reproducible safely in the emulator by seeding a legacy-shaped tournament (public joinCode, no private doc) and calling ctfJoinTeam with the code read from the public field.
